C1633.title: Using Virtual Currency for Cross-Platform Transfers to Conceal Criminal Proceeds
C1633.summary: From September to October 2020, defendants including An purchased virtual currency through OKEX and transferred it to designated virtual currency accounts, helping others conceal criminal proceeds and evade police tracing, constituting the crime of concealing or disguising criminal proceeds. If August 25, 2025 is recorded, it should be treated as the typical case publication date rather than the incident time.

references.title: Typical Cases of Lawfully Punishing Crimes of Concealing or Disguising Criminal Proceeds and Proceeds of Crime - Supreme People's Procuratorate of the PRC
